name: Food Aid Foundation
summary: Food bank that collects surplus food from businesses and redistributes it to welfare homes and low-income families, cutting both hunger and waste.
programmes: Food rescue from manufacturers, distributors and retailers
Distribution to welfare homes, refugee groups, soup kitchens and low-income families
Food drives with schools and companies
impact: RM20,431,564 worth of food distributed in 2024
beneficiaries: Welfare homes, refugee communities, low-income families and the homeless, mainly in the Klang Valley

organisation.founders: Rick Chee (Founder), ex-food and beverage industry veteran who funded the launch from his savings; Faisal Ghazali (Co-Founder)
organisation.leadership: Rick Chee (Founder, Director); Faisal Ghazali (Co-Founder, Director); Khairulbariah Binti Dzun Nurin, S. S Rajaa, Melvin Khoo (Directors); Afraz Said (General Manager); Dato' Seri Hj. Ibrahim Hj Ahmad Badawi (Chairman, Board of Advisors)
